reserveReview.rationale: The issuer's dated complete USDY Portfolio Overview now expressly identifies SHVon, an Ondo-tokenized iShares 0-1 Year Treasury Bond ETF position, rather than an unclassified Ondo Stocks-issued USDY remainder. The original structured page payload reports October 19, 2026 and exact liquidation values: US Treasuries $2,092,662,972.51; SHVon $294,161,417.02; Silicon Valley Bank bank deposits $599,553.01; other cash and equivalents $33,890.48. Their exact sum equals the same-payload portfolio total of $2,387,457,833.02; weights use only this common denominator. This independently dated issuer portfolio supersedes the September 25 LLC composition and its mixed-date September 29 supply residual. It does not reconcile current global USDY liabilities, establish all-USDY financial assurance, or assign OGM platform-wide collateral to USDY. The separately dated October 15 LLC attestation remains partial and is not applied to these weights. Treasury category WAM 206.57 days and SHVon/deposit/cash WAM 1 are not contractual maturity maxima or guaranteed liquidation times; no maturityDaysMax or immediate liquidity is inferred. SHVon retains the issuer tokenized-security layer, conservative high risk and unknown liquidity, rather than direct Treasury or direct ETF-share credit. The small other-cash/equivalents category remains explicitly unclassified. No current individual CUSIP weights are inferred from the older LLC report.
